info.title: Public Satisfaction Improvement
info.statisticsDescription: Shows a complete dashboard of current public satisfaction, including historical charts, factors that affect satisfaction (the economy, security, and public services), and a trend forecast for the next few days.
info.statisticsUse: Best for: in-depth analysis before making strategic decisions.
info.increaseDescription: Lists public events and programs the president can launch to improve public satisfaction. Each event has its own cost, duration, and satisfaction boost.
info.eventCompletion: Events run for their stated duration; the satisfaction boost takes effect when an event ends.
info.singleEvent: Only one instance of each event can be active at a time.
info.diplomacyBonus: The Event Diplomacy research bonus can significantly increase event boosts.
info.tip: Tip: Check the Statistics tab first to review current satisfaction, then choose the best-fit event from the Increase Satisfaction tab.

insufficientFunds.title: Insufficient Funds
insufficientFunds.description: The national treasury does not have enough funds to carry out this action.
